title: Stålheart's runtime LODs are in the game camera for review, behind one switch the lab and the game share; HUGIN is held back because its booster can no longer be hidden
context: The owner reported progress in jelaludo/SentryTowers_A6 at c827eda: LOD1 and LOD2 for HUGIN and Stålheart across D0–D3, inside numeric budgets, with required names, clips and dimensions preserved, Stålheart's animated hose omitted from LOD1, and the files marked pending game-camera and reference-phone review with no FPS claim. The upstream roadmap lists that review as the work remaining before the files can be called game-ready, which makes it this repository's work.
outcome: Every claim was measured rather than repeated. Stålheart LOD1 D0 is 7,342 triangles in 10 draws against the shipped 40,506 in 105; LOD2 is 2,173 in one. HUGIN LOD1 D0 is 7,190 in 7 against 39,731 in 90; LOD2 is 2,188 in one. Dimensions agree within 0.1%. Stålheart's clip keeps exactly nine controls — gantry, carriage, tool lift, J1–J6 — and drops exactly forty Flexible_carriage_material_feed segments; each kept control still carries geometry, which was measured because a clip can keep its node names while moving nothing. Stålheart is pinned for review in docs/landmark-tiers-assets.lock.json at c827eda: the plain files the author names as source of truth, D0 only because nothing uses D1–D3, the manifest listed first so a fetch verifies it before any tier is measured against it. All four hashes match the author's manifest. scripts/assets.mjs reads the lod1 and lod2 budgets from that pinned manifest instead of retyping them, and its count matches the author's README exactly: 7,342 / 10 / 329,364 bytes and 2,173 / 1 / 75,836. One mapping, withLandmarkTiers, and one parser, landmarkTierMode, live in src/content/base-layout.js beside the structures they change; the game world and the story lab both call them before planBase, which spreads every field through. td-tab passes the switch and reports the story base's lod and errors with no new lines (17,608 of 17,609). The story base now reports the file behind each tier, and a far tier only reports once its file has loaded, so the switch is tested on files rather than appearances. Packed for the release, the candidate game tier is 57.7 KB against the shipped 555.5 KB and the distance tier 17.9 KB. HUGIN is held back: its LOD1 and LOD2 keep the REUSABLE_BOOSTER node, but it carries no triangles against 6,572 in the shipped model, while 21.9% and 24.5% of their triangles sit in the booster's box against 1.6% of the shipped model with the booster removed — the geometry was merged, so the story's hide would do nothing, breaking the hideable-part rule in docs/ASSET-COLLABORATION.md. The game swaps landmark tiers at 150 m and back past 195 m, where the author's provisional contract says 150 m with 20 m of hysteresis; recorded as a question for the review. Two timing bugs in the browser suite were found and fixed: the new game-camera check read the frame rate while its moving average, seeded from zero, still said 0.58; and the existing story-world check behind a fixed three-second sleep read 22.7 at exactly 3.0 s, passing by a tenth of a second. Both now wait on the condition.
alternatives: Pin HUGIN's candidates anyway: rejected, the story would show a booster it deliberately hides.

Work around the merged booster in the game by culling triangles inside its box: rejected, guessing at merged geometry is the wrong side of the collaboration contract; the fix belongs in the A6 source.
Pin D1–D3 as well: rejected, nothing in the game uses them yet, and they would only add release weight.
Make the candidates the shipped tiers now: rejected, the author and the owner both mark them pending game-camera and reference-phone review.
Put the switch in a new module: rejected, base-layout.js already owns each landmark's tiers, and a candidate belongs beside what it would replace.
Lengthen the sleep before the frame-rate checks: rejected, a longer sleep is a slower guess; the checks wait on the condition.
evidence: test/landmark-tiers.mjs: shipped mode returns the same array; candidate mode swaps only structures with candidates and keeps clips and hides; one parser; every candidate file pinned and each shipped far tier still derived; Stålheart's nine controls carry geometry at the shipped size; its distance tier is static and one draw; HUGIN carries no candidate while its booster cannot be hidden.
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story: story-lab-candidate passes, then the arrival cases unchanged.

node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story-world: story-world-candidate passes in the real game camera at stage 6; story-world asserts a plain link still loads the shipped tiers; all twelve existing story-world cases pass.

npm test, npm run check (both locks, architecture), npm run build, npm run test:browser and node scripts/browser-test.mjs --dist pass. The release run covers the default suite; the landmark switch was verified against source, and the release build is confirmed to carry it.
